findings.title: Withdrawal answered by a dignifying word

findings.containment: The focus still describes a real turning away. The bodily/verbal reversal is a local reading across neighboring etiquette instructions, not proof that 17:28 deliberately reenacts the parent scene; the supplied HFT also allows parallel rules as an alternative.

epistemic.reason: The focus and contextual word/root coordinates are supplied and match; the relational synthesis and HFT roles remain attributed, with a live parallel-rules alternative.

findings.containment: The focus does not state literal insolvency or guarantee that provision will expand. The due's continuity is supported by the immediate sequence, while prudent discretion remains a live alternative to inability.
